```{r}
#==============================================================================
# MODULE 10 — Spatial inferCNV cancer-spot classification
#==============================================================================

# Purpose:
#   Interpret completed inferCNV results generated in Module 10. Calculate
#   genome-wide inferCNV burden for individual spatial spots, derive
#   sample-specific CNV-high thresholds from reference spots, classify
#   candidate tumor-region spots as malignant-enriched or CNV-low,
#   characterize chromosome-level HMM gains and losses, compare continuous
#   CNV dosage between candidate tumor and reference spots, examine recurrent
#   chr7 gain patterns, transfer inferCNV-derived metadata back to the
#   integrated four-slide spatial Seurat object, and save a stable
#   inferCNV-annotated spatial checkpoint for downstream analyses.
#
# Inputs:
#   data/processed/spatial/
#     spatial_integrated_clustered_seurat.rds
#
#   data/processed/spatial/infercnv/
#     infercnv_prepared_spatial_objects.rds
#     spatial_infercnv_result_index.rds
#
#   results/spatial/infercnv/
#     Niacin_Treatment/
#     Vehicle_1/
#     Vehicle_2/
#
# Primary output:
#   data/processed/spatial/
#     spatial_infercnv_annotated.rds
#
# Sample-level annotated objects:
#   data/processed/spatial/infercnv/classified/
#
# Output tables:
#   results/spatial/infercnv/cancer_spot_classification/
#   results/spatial/infercnv/cnv_characterization/
#
# Output figures:
#   figures/spatial/infercnv/cancer_spot_classification/
#   figures/spatial/infercnv/cnv_characterization/
#
# inferCNV-derived metadata:
#   infercnv_input_group
#   infercnv_score
#   infercnv_threshold
#   infercnv_status
#   malignancy_annotation
#
# Classification:
#   CNV burden:
#     mean(abs(inferCNV expression value - 1))
#
#   CNV-high threshold:
#     95th percentile of reference-spot CNV burden within each sample
#
#   Malignant-enriched:
#     candidate tumor-region observation spot AND CNV-high
#
# Notes:
#   - Normal tissue was not analyzed with inferCNV and is labeled
#     "Not assessed".
#   - inferCNV provides expression-based evidence consistent with large-scale
#     CNV patterns. It is not direct DNA-based proof of malignancy.
#   - Malignant-enriched annotations should be interpreted together with
#     histology, spatial localization, markers, and other biological evidence.
#==============================================================================


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load required packages
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(SeuratObject)
  library(infercnv)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(here)
})


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Reproducibility settings
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

set.seed(1234)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Define analysis parameters
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

sample_column <- "sample"

annotation_column <- "infercnv_input_group"

reference_label <- "reference"

observation_label <- "observation"

threshold_quantile <- 0.95

run_hmm_characterization <- TRUE

target_chr <- "chr7"

target_start <- 140.9e6

target_end <- 144.9e6

tumor_samples <- c(
  "Niacin_Treatment",
  "Vehicle_1",
  "Vehicle_2"
)

normal_sample <- "Normal_Tissue"

sample_titles <- c(
  Niacin_Treatment = "Niacin B5",
  Vehicle_1 = "Vehicle C5",
  Vehicle_2 = "Vehicle D5"
)

image_names <- c(
  Niacin_Treatment = "Niacin2_B5",
  Vehicle_1 = "Vehicle1_C5",
  Vehicle_2 = "Vehicle2_D5"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Define repository paths
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

processed_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "spatial"
)

infercnv_object_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "spatial",
  "infercnv"
)

classified_object_directory <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "spatial",
  "infercnv",
  "classified"
)

infercnv_results_directory <- here::here(
  "results",
  "spatial",
  "infercnv"
)

classification_results_directory <- here::here(
  "results",
  "spatial",
  "infercnv",
  "cancer_spot_classification"
)

cnv_results_directory <- here::here(
  "results",
  "spatial",
  "infercnv",
  "cnv_characterization"
)

classification_figure_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "spatial",
  "infercnv",
  "cancer_spot_classification"
)

cnv_figure_directory <- here::here(
  "figures",
  "spatial",
  "infercnv",
  "cnv_characterization"
)

directories_to_create <- c(
  classified_object_directory,
  classification_results_directory,
  cnv_results_directory,
  classification_figure_directory,
  cnv_figure_directory
)

for (directory in directories_to_create) {
  dir.create(
    directory,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Define input and output files
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

master_spatial_file <- file.path(
  processed_directory,
  "spatial_integrated_clustered_seurat.rds"
)

prepared_object_file <- file.path(
  infercnv_object_directory,
  "infercnv_prepared_spatial_objects.rds"
)

result_index_file <- file.path(
  infercnv_object_directory,
  "spatial_infercnv_result_index.rds"
)

final_master_object_file <- file.path(
  processed_directory,
  "spatial_infercnv_annotated.rds"
)

final_metadata_file <- file.path(
  classification_results_directory,
  "spatial_infercnv_final_metadata.csv"
)

parameter_file <- file.path(
  classification_results_directory,
  "spatial_infercnv_classification_parameters.csv"
)

cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "MODULE 11 — Spatial inferCNV cancer-spot classification\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  "Repository root:          ", here::here(), "\n",
  "Integrated spatial input: ", master_spatial_file, "\n",
  "Prepared inferCNV input:  ", prepared_object_file, "\n",
  "inferCNV result index:    ", result_index_file, "\n",
  "Classification results:  ", classification_results_directory, "\n",
  "CNV results:             ", cnv_results_directory, "\n",
  "Primary output:          ", final_master_object_file, "\n",
  "============================================================\n\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Validate required Module 10 inputs
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

required_input_files <- c(
  master_spatial_file,
  prepared_object_file,
  result_index_file
)

missing_input_files <- required_input_files[
  !file.exists(required_input_files)
]

if (length(missing_input_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Required Module 10 input file(s) were not found:\n",
    paste(
      missing_input_files,
      collapse = "\n"
    )
  )
}

cat(
  "Required Module 10 checkpoint files were found.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Load integrated master spatial object
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

spatial_master <- readRDS(
  master_spatial_file
)

if (!inherits(spatial_master, "Seurat")) {
  stop(
    "Integrated spatial input is not a valid Seurat object."
  )
}

if (!sample_column %in% colnames(spatial_master@meta.data)) {
  stop(
    "Sample metadata column was not found in master spatial object."
  )
}

cat(
  "\nIntegrated spatial object:\n",
  "  Features: ", nrow(spatial_master), "\n",
  "  Spots:    ", ncol(spatial_master), "\n",
  "  Samples:  ",
  length(
    unique(
      spatial_master@meta.data[[sample_column]]
    )
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Load inferCNV-prepared spatial objects
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

prepared_spatial_objects <- readRDS(
  prepared_object_file
)

if (!"Tumor_Samples" %in% names(prepared_spatial_objects)) {
  stop(
    "Prepared Module 10 object does not contain 'Tumor_Samples'."
  )
}

if (!"Normal_Tissue" %in% names(prepared_spatial_objects)) {
  stop(
    "Prepared Module 10 object does not contain 'Normal_Tissue'."
  )
}

seurat_objects <- prepared_spatial_objects$Tumor_Samples

normal_seurat <- prepared_spatial_objects$Normal_Tissue

missing_tumor_samples <- setdiff(
  tumor_samples,
  names(seurat_objects)
)

if (length(missing_tumor_samples) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Prepared tumor Seurat objects are missing:\n",
    paste(
      missing_tumor_samples,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

cat(
  "\nPrepared tumor-bearing spatial objects:\n"
)

print(
  vapply(
    seurat_objects,
    ncol,
    numeric(1)
  )
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Load inferCNV result index
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

infercnv_result_index <- readRDS(
  result_index_file
)

missing_index_samples <- setdiff(
  tumor_samples,
  names(infercnv_result_index)
)

if (length(missing_index_samples) > 0) {
  stop(
    "inferCNV result index is missing sample(s):\n",
    paste(
      missing_index_samples,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Load completed inferCNV objects
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

infercnv_objects <- list()

for (sample_name in tumor_samples) {
  current_result_file <- infercnv_result_index[[sample_name]]$result_file

  if (!file.exists(current_result_file)) {
    stop(
      "inferCNV result file was not found for ",
      sample_name,
      ":\n",
      current_result_file
    )
  }

  infercnv_objects[[sample_name]] <- readRDS(
    current_result_file
  )

  if (!inherits(infercnv_objects[[sample_name]], "infercnv")) {
    stop(
      "Loaded result is not an infercnv object for ",
      sample_name
    )
  }
}

cat(
  "\nCompleted inferCNV objects loaded successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Locate inferCNV HMM region files
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

hmm_files <- character(0)

for (sample_name in tumor_samples) {
  sample_output_directory <-
    infercnv_result_index[[sample_name]]$output_directory

  candidate_hmm_files <- list.files(
    sample_output_directory,
    pattern = "pred_cnv_regions\\.dat$",
    full.names = TRUE
  )

  if (length(candidate_hmm_files) == 0) {
    warning(
      "No HMM predicted CNV-region file found for ",
      sample_name
    )

    next
  }

  hmm_files[sample_name] <- candidate_hmm_files[1]
}

cat(
  "\nHMM CNV-region files detected:\n"
)

print(
  hmm_files
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12. Define genome-wide inferCNV burden function
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

score_infercnv_spots <- function(
    infercnv_object,
    seurat_object,
    annotation_column,
    reference_label,
    threshold_quantile
) {
  infercnv_matrix <- infercnv_object@expr.data

  if (nrow(infercnv_matrix) == 0 ||
      ncol(infercnv_matrix) == 0) {
    stop(
      "inferCNV expression matrix is empty."
    )
  }

  cnv_score <- apply(
    infercnv_matrix,
    2,
    function(x) {
      mean(
        abs(x - 1),
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    }
  )

  matched_spots <- intersect(
    names(cnv_score),
    colnames(seurat_object)
  )

  if (length(matched_spots) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No inferCNV barcodes matched the associated Seurat object."
    )
  }

  spot_metadata <- seurat_object@meta.data[
    matched_spots,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  if (!annotation_column %in% colnames(spot_metadata)) {
    stop(
      "Required inferCNV annotation column was not found: ",
      annotation_column
    )
  }

  score_table <- data.frame(
    spot = matched_spots,
    cnv_score = as.numeric(
      cnv_score[matched_spots]
    ),
    input_group = as.character(
      spot_metadata[[annotation_column]]
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  reference_scores <- score_table$cnv_score[
    score_table$input_group == reference_label
  ]

  if (length(reference_scores) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No reference spots were available for threshold calculation."
    )
  }

  cnv_threshold <- as.numeric(
    stats::quantile(
      reference_scores,
      probs = threshold_quantile,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )

  score_table$infercnv_status <- ifelse(
    score_table$cnv_score > cnv_threshold,
    "CNV-high",
    "CNV-low"
  )

  return(
    list(
      score_table = score_table,
      threshold = cnv_threshold
    )
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 13. Calculate inferCNV burden across tumor-bearing slides
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Calculating genome-wide inferCNV burden\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

infercnv_scoring_results <- list()

for (sample_name in tumor_samples) {
  cat(
    "\nScoring ",
    sample_titles[[sample_name]],
    "...\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  infercnv_scoring_results[[sample_name]] <-
    score_infercnv_spots(
      infercnv_object = infercnv_objects[[sample_name]],
      seurat_object = seurat_objects[[sample_name]],
      annotation_column = annotation_column,
      reference_label = reference_label,
      threshold_quantile = threshold_quantile
    )

  cat(
    "Reference-derived CNV-high threshold: ",
    signif(
      infercnv_scoring_results[[sample_name]]$threshold,
      5
    ),
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  print(
    table(
      infercnv_scoring_results[[sample_name]]$score_table$infercnv_status
    )
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 14. Add inferCNV scores and classifications to tumor Seurat objects
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Adding inferCNV scores to tumor Seurat objects\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

for (sample_name in tumor_samples) {
  score_table <-
    infercnv_scoring_results[[sample_name]]$score_table

  score_map <- stats::setNames(
    score_table$cnv_score,
    score_table$spot
  )

  status_map <- stats::setNames(
    score_table$infercnv_status,
    score_table$spot
  )

  seurat_objects[[sample_name]]$infercnv_score <-
    unname(
      score_map[
        colnames(seurat_objects[[sample_name]])
      ]
    )

  seurat_objects[[sample_name]]$infercnv_status <-
    unname(
      status_map[
        colnames(seurat_objects[[sample_name]])
      ]
    )

  seurat_objects[[sample_name]]$infercnv_threshold <-
    infercnv_scoring_results[[sample_name]]$threshold
}

cat(
  "inferCNV burden values added successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 15. Validate barcode scoring
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

barcode_summary <- data.frame()

for (sample_name in tumor_samples) {
  score_table <-
    infercnv_scoring_results[[sample_name]]$score_table

  matched_barcodes <- intersect(
    colnames(seurat_objects[[sample_name]]),
    score_table$spot
  )

  current_summary <- data.frame(
    sample = sample_name,
    seurat_spots = ncol(
      seurat_objects[[sample_name]]
    ),
    infercnv_scored_spots = nrow(
      score_table
    ),
    matched_spots = length(
      matched_barcodes
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  barcode_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    barcode_summary,
    current_summary
  )
}

cat(
  "\nBarcode matching summary:\n"
)

print(
  barcode_summary
)

barcode_summary_file <- file.path(
  classification_results_directory,
  "spatial_infercnv_barcode_matching_summary.csv"
)

utils::write.csv(
  barcode_summary,
  barcode_summary_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 16. Create malignant-enriched spot classification
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Creating malignant-enriched spot annotations\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

for (sample_name in tumor_samples) {
  current_object <- seurat_objects[[sample_name]]

  current_object$malignancy_annotation <- dplyr::case_when(
    current_object$infercnv_input_group == observation_label &
    current_object$infercnv_status == "CNV-high" ~
      "Malignant-enriched",

    current_object$infercnv_input_group == observation_label &
    current_object$infercnv_status == "CNV-low" ~
      "Tumor-region CNV-low",

    current_object$infercnv_input_group == reference_label ~
      "Non-malignant reference",

    TRUE ~
      "Not assessed"
  )

  seurat_objects[[sample_name]] <- current_object
}

cat(
  "\nFinal malignancy classifications:\n"
)

for (sample_name in tumor_samples) {
  cat(
    "\n",
    sample_titles[[sample_name]],
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  print(
    table(
      seurat_objects[[sample_name]]$malignancy_annotation,
      useNA = "ifany"
    )
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 17. Save sample-level inferCNV scoring tables
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

spot_score_files <- character(0)

for (sample_name in tumor_samples) {
  score_table <-
    infercnv_scoring_results[[sample_name]]$score_table

  score_table$sample <- sample_name

  score_table$threshold <-
    infercnv_scoring_results[[sample_name]]$threshold

  score_table$malignancy_annotation <-
    seurat_objects[[sample_name]]$malignancy_annotation[
      match(
        score_table$spot,
        colnames(seurat_objects[[sample_name]])
      )
    ]

  score_file <- file.path(
    classification_results_directory,
    paste0(
      sample_name,
      "_infercnv_spot_scores.csv"
    )
  )

  utils::write.csv(
    score_table,
    score_file,
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  spot_score_files <- c(
    spot_score_files,
    score_file
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 18. Save classification summary
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

classification_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(
    tumor_samples,
    function(sample_name) {
      seurat_objects[[sample_name]]@meta.data %>%
        dplyr::count(
          malignancy_annotation,
          name = "spots"
        ) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          sample = sample_name
        )
    }
  )
)

classification_summary <- classification_summary[, c(
  "sample",
  "malignancy_annotation",
  "spots"
)]

classification_summary_file <- file.path(
  classification_results_directory,
  "spatial_infercnv_classification_summary.csv"
)

utils::write.csv(
  classification_summary,
  classification_summary_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)

print(
  classification_summary
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 19. Plot inferCNV burden distributions
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cnv_score_plots <- list()

cnv_score_plot_files <- character(0)

for (sample_name in tumor_samples) {
  plot_data <-
    infercnv_scoring_results[[sample_name]]$score_table

  current_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    plot_data,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = input_group,
      y = cnv_score
    )
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_violin(
      trim = FALSE
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.15,
      outlier.shape = NA
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(
      yintercept =
        infercnv_scoring_results[[sample_name]]$threshold,
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste0(
        sample_titles[[sample_name]],
        " — inferCNV burden"
      ),
      subtitle =
        "Dashed line = reference-derived CNV-high threshold",
      x = NULL,
      y = "Genome-wide inferCNV burden"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw(
      base_size = 12
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(
        hjust = 0.5
      )
    )

  cnv_score_plots[[sample_name]] <- current_plot

  current_file <- file.path(
    classification_figure_directory,
    paste0(
      sample_name,
      "_infercnv_burden_by_input_group.png"
    )
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = current_file,
    plot = current_plot,
    width = 7,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 600
  )

  cnv_score_plot_files <- c(
    cnv_score_plot_files,
    current_file
  )
}

combined_cnv_score_plot <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
  cnv_score_plots,
  ncol = 3
)

combined_cnv_score_file <- file.path(
  classification_figure_directory,
  "combined_infercnv_burden_by_input_group.png"
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = combined_cnv_score_file,
  plot = combined_cnv_score_plot,
  width = 18,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 600
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 20. Generate spatial inferCNV burden maps
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cnv_spatial_plots <- list()

cnv_spatial_plot_files <- character(0)

for (sample_name in tumor_samples) {
  current_object <- seurat_objects[[sample_name]]

  image_name <- image_names[[sample_name]]

  if (!image_name %in% Seurat::Images(current_object)) {
    warning(
      "Spatial image was not found for ",
      sample_name,
      ": ",
      image_name
    )

    next
  }

  current_plot <- Seurat::SpatialFeaturePlot(
    current_object,
    features = "infercnv_score",
    images = image_name,
    pt.size.factor = 1.6
  ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste0(
        sample_titles[[sample_name]],
        " — inferCNV burden"
      )
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "bold"
      )
    )

  cnv_spatial_plots[[sample_name]] <- current_plot

  current_file <- file.path(
    classification_figure_directory,
    paste0(
      sample_name,
      "_spatial_infercnv_burden.png"
    )
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = current_file,
    plot = current_plot,
    width = 8,
    height = 8,
    dpi = 600
  )

  cnv_spatial_plot_files <- c(
    cnv_spatial_plot_files,
    current_file
  )
}

combined_cnv_spatial_file <- NULL

if (length(cnv_spatial_plots) > 0) {
  combined_cnv_spatial_plot <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
    cnv_spatial_plots,
    ncol = 3
  )

  combined_cnv_spatial_file <- file.path(
    classification_figure_directory,
    "combined_spatial_infercnv_burden.png"
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = combined_cnv_spatial_file,
    plot = combined_cnv_spatial_plot,
    width = 21,
    height = 7,
    dpi = 600
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 21. Generate spatial CNV-high / CNV-low maps
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cnv_status_plots <- list()

cnv_status_plot_files <- character(0)

for (sample_name in tumor_samples) {
  current_object <- seurat_objects[[sample_name]]

  image_name <- image_names[[sample_name]]

  if (!image_name %in% Seurat::Images(current_object)) {
    next
  }

  current_plot <- Seurat::SpatialDimPlot(
    current_object,
    group.by = "infercnv_status",
    images = image_name,
    pt.size.factor = 1.6
  ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste0(
        sample_titles[[sample_name]],
        " — CNV classification"
      )
    )

  cnv_status_plots[[sample_name]] <- current_plot

  current_file <- file.path(
    classification_figure_directory,
    paste0(
      sample_name,
      "_spatial_infercnv_status.png"
    )
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = current_file,
    plot = current_plot,
    width = 8,

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 23. Define interval-merging helper
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

merge_intervals <- function(interval_data) {
  interval_data <- interval_data %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      start,
      end
    )

  if (nrow(interval_data) == 0) {
    return(
      data.frame(
        start = numeric(0),
        end = numeric(0)
      )
    )
  }

  merged <- list()

  current_start <- interval_data$start[1]

  current_end <- interval_data$end[1]

  interval_number <- 1

  if (nrow(interval_data) > 1) {
    for (i in 2:nrow(interval_data)) {
      if (interval_data$start[i] <= current_end) {
        current_end <- max(
          current_end,
          interval_data$end[i]
        )
      } else {
        merged[[interval_number]] <- data.frame(
          start = current_start,
          end = current_end
        )

        interval_number <- interval_number + 1

        current_start <- interval_data$start[i]

        current_end <- interval_data$end[i]
      }
    }
  }

  merged[[interval_number]] <- data.frame(
    start = current_start,
    end = current_end
  )

  dplyr::bind_rows(
    merged
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 24. Define HMM chromosome-characterization function
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

analyze_hmm_regions <- function(
    hmm_file,
    sample_name
) {
  hmm_regions <- utils::read.delim(
    hmm_file,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  required_columns <- c(
    "cell_group_name",
    "cnv_name",
    "state",
    "chr",
    "start",
    "end"
  )

  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_columns,
    colnames(hmm_regions)
  )

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      "HMM file does not contain expected columns:\n",
      paste(
        missing_columns,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  }

  hmm_regions <- hmm_regions %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      cnv_type = dplyr::case_when(
        state == 2 ~ "Loss",
        state %in% c(5, 6) ~ "Gain",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(cnv_type)
    )

  merged_regions <- hmm_regions %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      chr,
      cnv_type
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_modify(
      ~ merge_intervals(.x)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      region_size_mb = (end - start) / 1e6
    )

  chromosome_summary <- merged_regions %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      chr,
      cnv_type
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      altered_mb = sum(
        region_size_mb
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      sample = sample_name,
      plot_mb = ifelse(
        cnv_type == "Loss",
        -altered_mb,
        altered_mb
      )
    )

  return(
    list(
      raw_regions = hmm_regions,
      merged_regions = merged_regions,
      chromosome_summary = chromosome_summary
    )
  )
}

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 26. Define chromosome-level CNV dosage function
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

calculate_chr_cnv_dosage <- function(
    infercnv_object,
    seurat_object,
    sample_name,
    annotation_column
) {
  cnv_matrix <- infercnv_object@expr.data

  gene_order <- infercnv_object@gene_order

  common_genes <- intersect(
    rownames(cnv_matrix),
    rownames(gene_order)
  )

  cnv_matrix <- cnv_matrix[
    common_genes,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  gene_order <- gene_order[
    common_genes,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  metadata <- seurat_object@meta.data

  observation_spots <- rownames(metadata)[
    metadata[[annotation_column]] == observation_label
  ]

  reference_spots <- rownames(metadata)[
    metadata[[annotation_column]] == reference_label
  ]

  observation_spots <- intersect(
    observation_spots,
    colnames(cnv_matrix)
  )

  reference_spots <- intersect(
    reference_spots,
    colnames(cnv_matrix)
  )

  if (length(observation_spots) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No observation spots matched for ",
      sample_name
    )
  }

  if (length(reference_spots) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No reference spots matched for ",
      sample_name
    )
  }

  observation_mean <- rowMeans(
    cnv_matrix[, observation_spots, drop = FALSE],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  reference_mean <- rowMeans(
    cnv_matrix[, reference_spots, drop = FALSE],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  gene_results <- data.frame(
    gene = common_genes,
    chromosome = gene_order$chr,
    observation_mean = observation_mean,
    reference_mean = reference_mean,
    cnv_difference =
      observation_mean -
      reference_mean,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  chromosome_results <- gene_results %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      chromosome
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      mean_cnv_difference = mean(
        cnv_difference,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      median_cnv_difference = median(
        cnv_difference,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      n_genes = dplyr::n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      sample = sample_name
    )

  return(
    list(
      chromosome_results = chromosome_results,
      gene_results = gene_results
    )
  )
}

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 29. Define gene-level CNV dosage function
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

calculate_gene_cnv_dosage <- function(
    infercnv_object,
    seurat_object,
    sample_name,
    chr,
    start,
    end,
    annotation_column
) {
  cnv_matrix <- infercnv_object@expr.data

  gene_order <- infercnv_object@gene_order

  if ("stop" %in% colnames(gene_order)) {
    gene_end <- gene_order$stop
  } else if ("end" %in% colnames(gene_order)) {
    gene_end <- gene_order$end
  } else {
    stop(
      "inferCNV gene_order does not contain 'stop' or 'end'."
    )
  }

  region_genes <- rownames(gene_order)[
    gene_order$chr == chr &
    gene_order$start <= end &
    gene_end >= start
  ]

  region_genes <- intersect(
    region_genes,
    rownames(cnv_matrix)
  )

  if (length(region_genes) == 0) {
    warning(
      "No genes were detected in the target region for ",
      sample_name
    )

    return(
      NULL
    )
  }

  metadata <- seurat_object@meta.data

  observation_spots <- rownames(metadata)[
    metadata[[annotation_column]] == observation_label
  ]

  reference_spots <- rownames(metadata)[
    metadata[[annotation_column]] == reference_label
  ]

  observation_spots <- intersect(
    observation_spots,
    colnames(cnv_matrix)
  )

  reference_spots <- intersect(
    reference_spots,
    colnames(cnv_matrix)
  )

  observation_mean <- rowMeans(
    cnv_matrix[
      region_genes,
      observation_spots,
      drop = FALSE
    ],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  reference_mean <- rowMeans(
    cnv_matrix[
      region_genes,
      reference_spots,
      drop = FALSE
    ],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  results <- data.frame(
    gene = region_genes,
    observation_mean = observation_mean,
    reference_mean = reference_mean,
    dosage_delta =
      observation_mean -
      reference_mean,
    chr = gene_order[
      region_genes,
      "chr"
    ],
    start = gene_order[
      region_genes,
      "start"
    ],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  if ("stop" %in% colnames(gene_order)) {
    results$end <- gene_order[
      region_genes,
      "stop"
    ]
  } else {
    results$end <- gene_order[
      region_genes,
      "end"
    ]
  }

  results$sample <- sample_name

  return(
    results
  )
}

# 32. Initialize inferCNV metadata in master spatial object

  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

spatial_infercnv <- spatial_master

spatial_infercnv$infercnv_input_group <- "Not assessed"

spatial_infercnv$infercnv_score <- NA_real_

spatial_infercnv$infercnv_threshold <- NA_real_

spatial_infercnv$infercnv_status <- "Not assessed"

spatial_infercnv$malignancy_annotation <- "Not assessed"

infercnv_metadata_columns <- c(
  "infercnv_input_group",
  "infercnv_score",
  "infercnv_threshold",
  "infercnv_status",
  "malignancy_annotation"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 33. Define barcode-normalization helper
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

normalize_spatial_barcode <- function(x) {
  sub(
    "^[^_]+_",
    "",
    x
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 34. Transfer tumor inferCNV metadata by barcode
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

transfer_summary <- data.frame()

for (sample_name in tumor_samples) {
  tumor_object <- seurat_objects[[sample_name]]

  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    infercnv_metadata_columns,
    colnames(tumor_object@meta.data)
  )

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      sample_name,
      " is missing inferCNV metadata column(s): ",
      paste(
        missing_columns,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  }

  master_sample_spots <- colnames(spatial_infercnv)[
    spatial_infercnv@meta.data[[sample_column]] ==
      sample_name
  ]

  tumor_spots <- colnames(
    tumor_object
  )

  direct_matches <- intersect(
    master_sample_spots,
    tumor_spots
  )

  if (length(direct_matches) > 0) {
    spatial_infercnv@meta.data[
      direct_matches,
      infercnv_metadata_columns
    ] <- tumor_object@meta.data[
      direct_matches,
      infercnv_metadata_columns
    ]
  }

  unmatched_master <- setdiff(
    master_sample_spots,
    direct_matches
  )

  normalized_matches <- 0

  if (length(unmatched_master) > 0) {
    master_normalized <- normalize_spatial_barcode(
      unmatched_master
    )

    tumor_normalized <- normalize_spatial_barcode(
      tumor_spots
    )

    barcode_index <- match(
      master_normalized,
      tumor_normalized
    )

    matched_index <- which(
      !is.na(barcode_index)
    )

    if (length(matched_index) > 0) {
      master_matched <- unmatched_master[
        matched_index
      ]

      tumor_matched <- tumor_spots[
        barcode_index[
          matched_index
        ]
      ]

      spatial_infercnv@meta.data[
        master_matched,
        infercnv_metadata_columns
      ] <- tumor_object@meta.data[
        tumor_matched,
        infercnv_metadata_columns
      ]

      normalized_matches <- length(
        matched_index
      )
    }
  }

  scored_sample_spots <- spatial_infercnv$infercnv_score[
    spatial_infercnv@meta.data[[sample_column]] ==
      sample_name
  ]

  current_transfer_summary <- data.frame(
    sample = sample_name,
    master_spots = length(
      master_sample_spots
    ),
    direct_matches = length(
      direct_matches
    ),
    normalized_matches = normalized_matches,
    scored_spots = sum(
      !is.na(scored_sample_spots)
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  transfer_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    transfer_summary,
    current_transfer_summary
  )
}

cat(
  "\nMetadata transfer summary:\n"
)

print(
  transfer_summary
)

transfer_summary_file <- file.path(
  classification_results_directory,
  "spatial_infercnv_metadata_transfer_summary.csv"
)

utils::write.csv(
  transfer_summary,
  transfer_summary_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 35. Validate final master inferCNV annotations
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n",
  "Validating final inferCNV-annotated spatial object\n",
  "------------------------------------------------------------\n"
)

cat(
  "\ninferCNV input groups by sample:\n"
)

print(
  table(
    spatial_infercnv@meta.data[[sample_column]],
    spatial_infercnv$infercnv_input_group,
    useNA = "ifany"
  )
)

cat(
  "\ninferCNV status by sample:\n"
)

print(
  table(
    spatial_infercnv@meta.data[[sample_column]],
    spatial_infercnv$infercnv_status,
    useNA = "ifany"
  )
)

cat(
  "\nMalignancy annotation by sample:\n"
)

print(
  table(
    spatial_infercnv@meta.data[[sample_column]],
    spatial_infercnv$malignancy_annotation,
    useNA = "ifany"
  )
)

normal_annotations <- spatial_infercnv$malignancy_annotation[
  spatial_infercnv@meta.data[[sample_column]] ==
    normal_sample
]

if (!all(normal_annotations == "Not assessed")) {
  stop(
    "Normal tissue contains unexpected inferCNV malignancy annotations."
  )
}

if (anyDuplicated(colnames(spatial_infercnv)) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Duplicated spot barcodes detected in final spatial object."
  )
}

expected_images <- c(
  "Naive_A9",
  "Niacin2_B5",
  "Vehicle1_C5",
  "Vehicle2_D5"
)

missing_images <- setdiff(
  expected_images,
  Seurat::Images(spatial_infercnv)
)

if (length(missing_images) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Spatial image(s) missing from final object:\n",
    paste(
      missing_images,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

cat(
  "Final inferCNV-annotated spatial object validation passed.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 36. Save final master spatial object
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

saveRDS(
  object = spatial_infercnv,
  file = final_master_object_file,
  compress = TRUE
)

if (!file.exists(final_master_object_file)) {
  stop(
    "Final inferCNV-annotated spatial object was not saved successfully."
  )
}


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 37. Save complete inferCNV metadata table
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

final_metadata <- spatial_infercnv@meta.data

final_metadata$spot <- rownames(
  final_metadata
)

utils::write.csv(
  final_metadata,
  final_metadata_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 38. Save classification parameters
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

classification_parameters <- data.frame(
  parameter = c(
    "CNV_score_definition",
    "reference_label",
    "observation_label",
    "threshold_quantile",
    "malignant_definition",
    "normal_tissue_status",
    "chr7_target_region"
  ),
  value = c(
    "mean(abs(inferCNV_value - 1))",
    reference_label,
    observation_label,
    threshold_quantile,
    "observation AND CNV-high",
    "Not assessed",
    paste0(
      target_chr,
      ":",
      target_start,
      "-",
      target_end
    )
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

utils::write.csv(
  classification_parameters,
  parameter_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 39. Validate expected Module 11 outputs
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

expected_object_files <- c(
  final_master_object_file,
  annotated_tumor_object_files
)

expected_result_files <- c(
  spot_score_files,
  barcode_summary_file,
  classification_summary_file,
  transfer_summary_file,
  final_metadata_file,
  parameter_file,
  chr_dosage_summary_file
)

if (!is.null(combined_hmm_summary_file)) {
  expected_result_files <- c(
    expected_result_files,
    hmm_summary_files,
    combined_hmm_summary_file
  )
}

if (!is.null(chr7_gene_file)) {
  expected_result_files <- c(
    expected_result_files,
    chr7_gene_file,
    chr7_summary_file
  )
}

expected_figure_files <- c(
  cnv_score_plot_files,
  combined_cnv_score_file,
  cnv_spatial_plot_files,
  cnv_status_plot_files,
  malignancy_plot_files,
  chr_dosage_heatmap_file,
  hmm_plot_files
)

optional_combined_figures <- c(
  combined_cnv_spatial_file,
  combined_cnv_status_file,
  combined_malignancy_file,
  chr7_plot_file
)

optional_combined_figures <- optional_combined_figures[
  !vapply(
    optional_combined_figures,
    is.null,
    logical(1)
  )
]

expected_figure_files <- c(
  expected_figure_files,
  optional_combined_figures
)

missing_object_files <- expected_object_files[
  !file.exists(expected_object_files)
]

missing_result_files <- expected_result_files[
  !file.exists(expected_result_files)
]

missing_figure_files <- expected_figure_files[
  !file.exists(expected_figure_files)
]

if (length(missing_object_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    "One or more expected Module 11 object files were not created:\n",
    paste(
      missing_object_files,
      collapse = "\n"
    )
  )
}

if (length(missing_result_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    "One or more expected Module 11 result files were not created:\n",
    paste(
      missing_result_files,
      collapse = "\n"
    )
  )
}

if (length(missing_figure_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    "One or more expected Module 11 figure files were not created:\n",
    paste(
      missing_figure_files,
      collapse = "\n"
    )
  )
}

cat(
  "All expected Module 11 outputs were created successfully.\n"
)


#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 40. Final module summary
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

malignant_spots <- sum(
  spatial_infercnv$malignancy_annotation ==
    "Malignant-enriched",
  na.rm = TRUE
)

cnv_high_spots <- sum(
  spatial_infercnv$infercnv_status ==
    "CNV-high",
  na.rm = TRUE
)

cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "MODULE 11 COMPLETE — Spatial inferCNV cancer-spot classification\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  "Tumor-bearing samples:    ", length(tumor_samples), "\n",

  "CNV-high spots:           ", cnv_high_spots, "\n",

  "Normal tissue:            Not assessed\n",
  "HMM files analyzed:       ", length(hmm_results), "\n",
  "\n",
  "Primary downstream object:\n",
  "  ", final_master_object_file, "\n",
  "\n",
  "Sample-level classified objects:\n",

  "Classification tables:\n",

  "\n",

  "\n",

  "\n",
  "CNV characterization figures:\n",
  "  ", cnv_figure_directory, "\n",
  "\n",
  "Next module:\n",

  "============================================================\n\n",
  sep = ""
)
```
